comments.headline: Landscape sheets improperly numbered within plan set
comments.summary: Landscape sheets (30-37) are numbered according to a separate document's sequencing system (27-34 of 35), indicating they were not properly integrated into the 39-sheet plan set. All sheets must use sequential numbering reflecting their actual position in the consolidated plan.
comments.attn: Details for 3:ZLU-3.1 and 3:ZLU-3.7 based on single review run only; verify sheet identification and title block content on all landscape sheets 30-37.

details.text: Sheet count notation is inconsistent: sheets 1-29 and 38-39 show "X of 39", while landscape sheets 30-37 show "X of 35" in their title blocks.

runComments.comment: The 'Y' total sheet count in the X of Y format is inconsistent across the plan set. Sheets 1-29 and sheets 38-39 show 'of 39', while landscape sheets 30-37 show 'of 35'. The cover sheet index indicates 39 total sheets, but landscape sheets reference a 35-sheet total.

The 'Y' total sheet count in the title block is inconsistent across the plan set. Sheets 1-29 correctly display 'X of 39', but landscape sheets 30-37 incorrectly display 'of 35' (showing sheet numbers 27-34 of 35 instead of 30-37 of 39). The cover sheet approval block and sheet index clearly establish 39 total sheets. All sheets in a plan set must reflect the same total sheet count regardless of discipline.

The landscape sheets (prepared by Blu Fish Collaborative) show an incorrect total sheet count in the 'Y' position of the 'X of Y' format. These sheets are numbered as part of a 35-sheet set (e.g., '27 of 35', '28 of 35', '33 of 35', '34 of 35') rather than the 39-sheet set indicated on the cover sheet approval block and sheet index. All sheets in the plan set must display the consistent and accurate total count of 39 in the lower right corner.

details.text: Landscape sheets are numbered 27-34 of 35 in individual title blocks with attribution to Blu Fish Collaborative, indicating they were extracted from a separate 35-sheet landscape document rather than properly integrated.

runComments.comment: Landscape sheets are not properly integrated into the overall sequential whole-number numbering system. Although listed as sheets 30-37 in the cover sheet index, they show numbering as 27-34 of 35, indicating they were pulled from a separate document set with its own numbering sequence.

The landscape sheets are not integrated into the plan set's overall sequential whole-number numbering system. They are numbered as part of a separate 35-sheet set rather than the combined 39-sheet plan set. Landscape sheets must be renumbered to be sequential with the full plan set (e.g., sheets 30-37 should be properly identified with their actual position in the overall 39-sheet sequence with 'X of 39' notation).

details.text: While the cover sheet index lists sheets 30-37 for landscape and exhibit content (Existing Tree Plan, Landscape Plan, Tree List, Canopy Impact Exhibit, Root Zone Impact Exhibit, Landscape Calculations, Biofiltration Pond Plans, Landscape Details), individual sheets display numbering of 27-34 of 35.

runComments.comment: Landscape and exhibit sheets (Existing Tree Plan, Landscape Plan, Tree List, Canopy Impact Exhibit, Root Zone Impact Exhibit, Landscape Calculations, Biofiltration Pond Plans, Landscape Details) are numbered as sheets 30-37 on the cover sheet index but show numbering as 27-34 of 35 in their individual title blocks, indicating inconsistent sequential numbering.

details.text: Cover sheet index lists sheets 30-37 sequentially, but the actual sheets display different numbers (27-34) and a different total count (35), creating mismatch between index and individual sheet identification.

runComments.comment: Sheet index on the cover sheet lists sheets 30-37 with sequential numbering as 'Existing Tree Plan', 'Landscape Plan', 'Tree List', etc., but individual sheets display different numbering (27-34 of 35) in their title blocks, creating a mismatch between index and actual sheet identification.

comments.headline: Wall sheets appear to be from different project entirely
comments.summary: Wall sheets 38-39 display project identification (Pecan Valley Homes, MLAW Engineers), professional engineer name, title block format, and dates (2015–2023) inconsistent with the primary submission (Valley View Townhomes, Bleyl Engineering, dated 5/20/25). These sheets appear to have been incorrectly included from a different project and require clarification or removal.
comments.crossDep: Applicant and original PE (Bleyl Engineering) must clarify whether wall sheets 38-39 are part of this project or included in error.
comments.attn: All details in this comment based on single review run; confirm with applicant that sheets 38-39 belong to this project. If included, sheets must be completely resubmitted with current project information, engineer seal, and appropriate dates.

details.text: Sheet 38 is dated 11/30/23 and sheet 39 is dated 11/3/2015. Title blocks identify project as "Pecan Valley Homes" prepared by MLAW Engineers (Michael Ray Lynch), not Valley View Townhomes by Bleyl Engineering.

runComments.comment: Sheets 38-39 (Wall Plans) appear to be from a different project. The title blocks identify the project as 'Pecan Valley Homes' with engineer 'MLAW Engineers' (Michael Ray Lynch), not 'Valley View Townhomes' by Bleyl Engineering. Sheet 38 is dated 11/30/23 and Sheet 39 is dated 11/3/2015, inconsistent with the overall project submittal date of 5/20/25. These sheets should not be included in this site plan submission without proper integration and confirmation of applicability.

details.text: Submittal dates conflict sharply: cover sheet shows 5/20/25 with engineer signature dated 2/27/26, while wall sheets show 11/30/23 and 11/3/2015, indicating sheets from different projects or submittals.

runComments.comment: Submittal dates are drastically inconsistent across sheets. Cover sheet shows submittal date of 5/20/25 and engineer signature date of 2/27/26. Wall sheets show date of 11/30/23 (Sheet 38) and 11/3/2015 (Sheet 39). These date discrepancies indicate sheets from different projects or submittals have been improperly combined into a single plan set.
